provenance.tools: Python 3 standard library (re, json, str.find) and lxml, run from tools/ scripts to search wikitext and list <sup typeof=mw:Extension/ref> and <li id=cite_note-*>; every location verified with text[cp:cp+len(quote)]==quote. Labels decided by reading the text.
provenance.unresolved: None. Window [17198,25198) holds only self-closing <ref name="Abraham09" /> uses; no definitions start inside it, no DOI/PMID text inside it.

definitions.name: Abraham09
definitions.notes: First definition of Abraham09, outside the window (listed so the in-window uses can bind to it). Hand-written citation ending in {{doi|10.1002/jps.21922}} (a wrapper, not a citation template). Defined in a table cell and reused ~160 times.
